description:
✨ North-West Zonal Membership Workshop ✨

The North-West Zonal Membership Workshop, held on 20th September and hosted by the Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli, was an enriching, interactive and highly informative learning experience. 🙌

27 Rotarians from across the zone participated in the workshop, making it a wonderful platform to learn, connect and exchange ideas. 🤝❤️

A heartfelt thank you to PP Rtn. S. B. Prasad Sir for sharing his valuable knowledge and experience through an engaging and practical approach. 👏✨

The workshop featured case study-based learning on membership growth, along with live interactive demonstrations on how to retain existing members and effectively engage and add new members**. The practical approach made the session insightful, relatable and easy to implement at the club level.

🏅 Participation Certificates were presented to all participants in appreciation of their enthusiastic involvement.

Connect • Engage • Grow
location: Evershine Club, Thakur Village, Mumbai, Maharashtra
